mapper.sql: from quiz_record latest inner join ( select question_id, max(id) as latest_record_id from quiz_record where user_id = #{userId} group by question_id ) newest on newest.latest_record_id = latest.id inner join quiz_question q on q.id = latest.question_id and q.status = '0' left join ( select question_id, count(*) as wrong_count from quiz_record where user_id = #{userId} and is_correct = 0 group by question_id ) wrongs on wrongs.question_id = latest.question_id
mapper.insert: insert into quiz_record (user_id, question_id, session_id, user_answer, is_correct, score, time_spent_sec, answer_time, create_time) values (#{userId}, #{questionId}, #{sessionId}, #{userAnswer}, #{isCorrect}, #{score}, #{timeSpentSec}, #{answerTime}, sysdate())
mapper.select: select * from quiz_record where user_id = #{userId} order by create_time desc limit #{limit}
select * from quiz_record where user_id = #{userId} and question_id = #{questionId} order by create_time desc

select count(*) as total, coalesce(sum(case when qr.is_correct = 1 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as correct, coalesce(round(avg(qr.time_spent_sec), 0), 0) as avgTimeSec, count(*) as answeredCount, coalesce(sum(case when qr.is_correct = 1 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as correctCount, coalesce(round( 100.0 * sum(case when qr.is_correct = 1 then 1 else 0 end) / nullif(count(*), 0), 1 ), 0) as correctRate, coalesce(round(avg(qr.time_spent_sec), 0), 0) as averageSeconds, coalesce(sum(case when question.question_type in ('single_choice', 'multi_choice', 'fill_blank') and qr.is_correct is not null and coalesce(practice_item.pending_review, 0) = 0 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as objectiveAnsweredCount, coalesce(sum(case when question.question_type in ('single_choice', 'multi_choice', 'fill_blank') and qr.is_correct = 1 and coalesce(practice_item.pending_review, 0) = 0 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as objectiveCorrectCount, coalesce(round( 100.0 * sum(case when question.question_type in ('single_choice', 'multi_choice', 'fill_blank') and qr.is_correct = 1 and coalesce(practice_item.pending_review, 0) = 0 then 1 else 0 end) / nullif(sum(case when question.question_type in ('single_choice', 'multi_choice', 'fill_blank') and qr.is_correct is not null and coalesce(practice_item.pending_review, 0) = 0 then 1 else 0 end), 0), 1 ), 0) as objectiveCorrectRate, coalesce(sum(case when qr.is_correct is null or coalesce(practice_item.pending_review, 0) = 1 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as pendingReviewCount from quiz_record qr left join quiz_question question on question.id = qr.question_id left join ( select quiz_record_id, max(pending_review) as pending_review from quiz_practice_item where quiz_record_id is not null group by quiz_record_id ) practice_item on practice_item.quiz_record_id = qr.id where qr.user_id = #{userId}

select count(*) as total, coalesce(sum(case when qr.is_correct = 1 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as correct, coalesce(round(avg(qr.time_spent_sec), 0), 0) as avgTimeSec, count(*) as answeredCount, coalesce(sum(case when qr.is_correct = 1 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as correctCount, coalesce(round( 100.0 * sum(case when qr.is_correct = 1 then 1 else 0 end) / nullif(count(*), 0), 1 ), 0) as correctRate, coalesce(round(avg(qr.time_spent_sec), 0), 0) as averageSeconds, coalesce(sum(case when question.question_type in ('single_choice', 'multi_choice', 'fill_blank') and qr.is_correct is not null and coalesce(practice_item.pending_review, 0) = 0 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as objectiveAnsweredCount, coalesce(sum(case when question.question_type in ('single_choice', 'multi_choice', 'fill_blank') and qr.is_correct = 1 and coalesce(practice_item.pending_review, 0) = 0 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as objectiveCorrectCount, coalesce(round( 100.0 * sum(case when question.question_type in ('single_choice', 'multi_choice', 'fill_blank') and qr.is_correct = 1 and coalesce(practice_item.pending_review, 0) = 0 then 1 else 0 end) / nullif(sum(case when question.question_type in ('single_choice', 'multi_choice', 'fill_blank') and qr.is_correct is not null and coalesce(practice_item.pending_review, 0) = 0 then 1 else 0 end), 0), 1 ), 0) as objectiveCorrectRate, coalesce(sum(case when qr.is_correct is null or coalesce(practice_item.pending_review, 0) = 1 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as pendingReviewCount from quiz_record qr left join quiz_question question on question.id = qr.question_id left join ( select quiz_record_id, max(pending_review) as pending_review from quiz_practice_item where quiz_record_id is not null group by quiz_record_id ) practice_item on practice_item.quiz_record_id = qr.id where qr.user_id = #{userId} and coalesce(qr.answer_time, qr.create_time) >= date_sub(curdate(), interval (#{days} - 1) day)

select date(coalesce(qr.answer_time, qr.create_time)) as date, coalesce(sum(case when question.question_type in ('single_choice', 'multi_choice', 'fill_blank') and qr.is_correct is not null and coalesce(practice_item.pending_review, 0) = 0 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as assessed_count, coalesce(sum(case when question.question_type in ('single_choice', 'multi_choice', 'fill_blank') and qr.is_correct = 1 and coalesce(practice_item.pending_review, 0) = 0 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as correct_count from quiz_record qr left join quiz_question question on question.id = qr.question_id left join ( select quiz_record_id, max(pending_review) as pending_review from quiz_practice_item where quiz_record_id is not null group by quiz_record_id ) practice_item on practice_item.quiz_record_id = qr.id where qr.user_id = #{userId} and coalesce(qr.answer_time, qr.create_time) >= date_sub(curdate(), interval (#{days} - 1) day) group by date(coalesce(qr.answer_time, qr.create_time)) order by date asc

select q.id, q.question_type, q.stem, q.options, q.difficulty, q.knowledge_points, coalesce(wrongs.wrong_count, 0) as wrong_count, coalesce(latest.answer_time, latest.create_time) as last_wrong_at
order by last_wrong_at desc, latest.id desc limit #{query.offset}, #{query.pageSize}
